_doc: Manual reading of every answer whose tree (edition 3) or typed IR (edition 2) differs from every ground truth. Verdicts: equivalent (same rows, same column names); renamed (same rows, other column names); extra (the asked rows plus columns or an ordering not asked for); alternative (a defensible reading of the task with different rows on some data); wrong (refused by the full compiler, or answers another question). Keys are edition/task/run; 'all' covers every run listed in the summary.
2/m3/all: the count block written after the traversal; the IR keeps the written order
2/t13/all: `$d in $c`: membership, refused by today's type checker with T7; run 1 also writes a second variant
2/t27/all: bare `order { bm25(...) }`: the IR keeps no direction, the engine sorts descending (checked on a local graph)
2/t29/all: `rrf(...)` without the constant; the default is 60 (same rows on a local graph)
3/m3/2: two candidate declarations of one name, the first without the threshold
3/m4/1: `from { ... return { $q.handle as h1 } }  from colleagues($h1)`, simpler than the asset's double wrapper; `$q.handle != $p.handle` for `$q != $p`
3/m4/3: `from colleagues($of)` then an inner `from colleagues($q.handle)`: the inner call binds `$q` while the outer `$q` is in scope, T68 under section 5; the parser-only build accepts it
3/t11/all: `return distinct`: differs only when two neighbours share a name
3/t12/all: the recursive read plus a wrapper declaration that projects the names
3/t15/all: `let $headcount = count { $p worksAt $c }`: keeps companies with no employees at 0, which the grouped truth drops
3/t17/all: `let $n = count { ... }`: companies with no employees count in the mean
3/t23/all: adds `$p.age is not null` (and run 1 and 2 return the age)
3/t24/all: `from distance(...)` with `order { $distance } limit 20`: the exact top 20 instead of the approximate window `nearest(..., k: 20)`
3/t30/all: the two rankings drawn through wrapper reads in another arrangement (run 2 adds the lexical filter to the vector arm, which the join implies)
